Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MMC.
We delivered record revenue of $17.9 billion this quarter, representing 25% year-over-year growth.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 25% to 27% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2019.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $7.57 per share.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 387 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
